note: Independently re-derived by the project owner: confirmed _mask_quoted_regions masks only string literals and quoted identifiers (its own docstring says so, and the scan loop tests membership in quote_chars only), and that no part of the diff mentions comments. Finding: a commented-out constraint such as '-- CHECK (id > 0)' is scanned as live text and re-emitted as an ACTIVE constraint after transform(), so a table that accepted id = -1 starts rejecting it. Second issue: with drop={'a'}, a compound CHECK (a > 0 AND b > 0) is discarded whole, silently losing the b half. The fix is otherwise genuine but partial - the agent's own REPORT.md defers comments openly, so 'fixes #762' would overclaim. Fix the comment masking before this goes upstream.
